headline.zh: 船厂老厂房里的音乐咖啡站
headline.en: A music-focused coffee station in a historic shipyard building

traits.zh: 前身是上海船厂修船分厂3号厂房，保留铁轨及钢架结构
traits.en: Former Shanghai Shipyard repair workshop No. 3, retaining original rails and steel framework

traits.zh: 位于杨浦滨江步道南段，可吹江风
traits.en: Located on the southern section of Yangpu Riverside Promenade, with river breeze access

traits.zh: 设有室外座位与金属栏杆围合的露台区域
traits.en: Outdoor seating area with metal railings, visible in photos

traits.zh: 每周五、六晚有固定现场Live Show，所有工作人员都是歌手
traits.en: Fixed live music shows every Friday and Saturday evening; all staff are singers

traits.zh: 提供烤鸡翅配炸物，用报纸包裹
traits.en: Serves grilled chicken wings with fried items, wrapped in newspaper

energy.zh: 周末宠物多+每晚现场演唱
energy.en: Weekend pet traffic + nightly live music

linger.zh: 宠物友好、每晚演出、堂食送餐到桌
linger.en: Pet-friendly, nightly shows, table service for dine-in

adventure.zh: 推荐菜含鱿鱼与巧克力，非典型咖啡馆菜单
adventure.en: Featured dishes include squid and chocolate, atypical for cafés
